summary: Frontend-only smoke test for deployment-readiness asset-path change. Verified brand images (logo.png, banner.png) load from the new relative /brand/* public paths on Dashboard, /campaign and /funnel. No broken images, no console errors, DE/EN toggle works, 11 module cards rendered.

verification_details.de_en_toggle: Works - hero changed from 'Alles im Corporate Design. Auf einen Klick.' (DE) to 'All in your corporate design. One click.' (EN)

critical_code_review_comments: Banner image is rendered as (with alt='KickstarterCash') rather than as CSS background-image - this is fine but slightly different from the original test wording ('hero banner background image'). The banner.png is still loaded and visible. No action needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Asset paths now relative under /brand/* served from frontend public folder. All three relative URLs (logo.png, banner.png, skyline.jpg present in /app/frontend/public/brand/) are reachable. Dashboard, /campaign, /funnel all render logo correctly. No regressions detected.
